definition: to close a door with a key
description: In a zoo yard at dusk, wet with rain and scattered with straw, a young man in a navy fleece, work trousers and green wellington boots stands at a heavy green wooden door in a stone wall and turns a big key in the lock under a glowing lamp. Then he steps back from the door and turns, surprised, towards a crowd of king penguins standing behind him. One king penguin stands right next to the door looking up, a few lie on their bellies, and a keeper with a wheelbarrow waits in the mist.

en.question: What is the man in front doing?

de.answer: Er schließt die grüne Tür ab.
de.question: Was macht der Mann vorne gerade?

es.answer: Está cerrando con llave la puerta verde.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre de delante?

fr.answer: Il ferme la porte verte à clé.
